::: {#rem-induction-template}
#### The shape of a proof by induction

A proof by induction that $P(n)$ holds for every integer $n \ge n_0$ has two parts:

> | **Base case.** Show $P(n_0)$.
> |
> | **Inductive step.** Let $k \ge n_0$ be an integer, and suppose $P(k)$.
> | $\vdots$
> | Therefore $P(k + 1)$.
> |
> | So $P(n)$ holds for every integer $n \ge n_0$, by induction.

Write out the induction hypothesis $P(k)$ and the goal $P(k + 1)$ before starting the step,
and mark the line where the step uses the hypothesis.

:::
